title: 第17章 带路我去地府走一趟第18章 提前了解地府内的情况没必要
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
牛头马面。
它们哥俩一起干了数千年这种差事。
从未遇到过如此之怪的事情！
它们心慌到不行。
到底怎么一回事啊？
“我刚才又听到他咳嗽了一声…”
牛头又看向了陈长生，小声的说道。
“前面他咳嗽了一声，阴力随后消散不见，这次他又咳嗽了一声，阴力也随后消散不见！”
它忍不住的说道：“没这么巧合吧？”
“你说什么呢！
活着的生灵，怎么可能消散阴力？啊…什么鬼，他真能看到我们？！”
马面不信。
认定这就是巧合。
然而，它话还没有说完。
它就看到陈长生正在直勾勾的看着它们哥俩！
这眼神明显就是能看到它们哥俩啊！
它吓得浑身一颤。
活着的生灵怎么可能看得到它们哥俩？！
“过来，我问你们两个一些事情。”
陈长生开口，对牛头马面说道。

“啊这！
！”
“他在跟我们说话吗？这怎么可能！”
牛头马面吓坏了。
圣地老祖们和血魔全都懵了。
陈长生在跟谁说话呢？
它们全都看不到牛头马面。
“牛头，马面，就是跟你俩说话呢，过来。”
陈长生冲着牛头马面挥了挥手。
“！
！”
牛头马面变色。
当即撒腿就跑。
妈呀…
活着的生灵，居然能看到它们哥俩！
它们哥俩差点没被活活吓死！
“站住！”
陈长生轻喝。
刹那间，无形力量锁定牛头马面。
牛头马面被定在当场。

一动也动不了！
content_en:
Bull head and horse noodles.
The two brothers have been doing this job together for thousands of years.
I have never encountered anything so strange!
They were so flustered.
What's going on?
"I just heard him cough again..."
Niutou looked at Chen Changsheng again and whispered.
"He coughed before, and the Yin force disappeared. This time he coughed again, and the Yin force also dissipated!"
It couldn't help but said: "It's not such a coincidence, is it?"
"What did you say!
How can a living creature dissipate Yin power? Ah...what the hell, can he really see us? ! "
Ma Mian didn't believe it.
Decided this to be a coincidence.
However, it wasn't finished yet.
It saw Chen Changsheng looking directly at the two brothers!
It's obvious that these two brothers can be seen in these eyes!
It trembled with fear.
How could living creatures see these two brothers? !
"Come here, let me ask you two something."
Chen Changsheng opened his mouth and said to the ox-headed horse face.
"Ah this!
! "
"Is he talking to us? How is that possible!"
The bull-headed horse-faced man was frightened.
The ancestors of the Holy Land and the Blood Demon were all confused.
Who is Chen Changsheng talking to?
None of them can see the bull's head or horse's face.
"Ox Head, Horse Face, I'm just talking to you two, come here."
Chen Changsheng waved his hand towards the bull-headed horse face.
"!
! "
The face of the bull-headed horse changes color.
He immediately ran away.
Oh my god...
Living creatures can actually see these two brothers!
The two brothers were almost scared to death!
"Stop!"
Chen Changsheng drank lightly.
In an instant, invisible force locked on the bull-headed horse's face.
The bull head and horse face were fixed on the spot.
I can't move at all!
